items.name: Wise Green
items.role: The brand's universal CTA color. Every primary button, every "Send money" pill, the brand's logo accent.

items.name: Wise Green Hover
items.role: The lighter green for active state.

items.name: Wise Green Neutral
items.role: A mid-saturation green used as a neutral active fill.

items.name: Wise Green Pale
items.role: The lightest green for soft surface tints / badge backgrounds.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: Pure white for card interiors.

items.name: Canvas Soft
items.role: The sage-tinted page background. Defining mood of the brand.

items.name: Ink
items.role: Near-black with a hint of olive warmth — the brand's default text and headings color.

items.name: Ink Deep
items.role: A deep forest-green ink used on positive-state surfaces.

items.name: Body
items.role: Secondary body text.

items.name: Mute
items.role: Lowest-priority text — captions, placeholder, fine print.

items.name: Positive
items.role: Success indicator.

items.name: Positive Deep
items.role: Pressed positive state.

items.name: Warning
items.role: Caution indicator.

items.name: Warning Deep
items.role: Pressed warning.

items.name: Warning Content
items.role: Text on warning surfaces.

items.name: Negative
items.role: Destructive / error red.

items.name: Negative Deep
items.role: Pressed destructive.

items.name: Negative Darkest
items.role: Highest-emphasis destructive text.

items.name: Negative Bg
items.role: Dark maroon for destructive callout backgrounds.

items.name: Accent Orange
items.role: Bright peach used inside illustrative content / pricing cards.

items.name: Accent Cyan
items.role: Bright sky-blue used as a tertiary illustration accent.
